theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the confirmed leader with the highest durability bar on the tape (0.68) and unusually broad participation (breadth 0.786 — the only theme anywhere near a wide advance), and the trend gate is positive. Leader, not laggard, with the staying-power leg intact. Crowding (z 1.04) is a cap-the-size caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding z 1.04 with a mixed Hurst tag and weight already 0.25 flags that this lead is reflexively extended — the exact condition where attention spikes historically mark a local top; R10 momentum of 0.0298 is modest, not accelerating.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags XGD.TO by 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the only non-crowded challenger with a positive trend gate and the second-highest score (1.11). Durability is modest (0.48) and breadth is thin (0.267), so this is a secondary, smaller-conviction lean rather than a leadership call — a trend-following allocation to the challenger in case the Oil & Gas lead stalls.
theses.dissent: Breadth 0.267 means the move is concentrated, not broad; mixed Hurst and mean-reverting characteristics on Silver/Royalties just below suggest precious metals momentum may not persist through a full cycle.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms ZEB.TO by 4% on the next 3-week stretch

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables are trend-gate ineligible (score -0.115) despite a trend Hurst tag — the trend discipline's one validated edge (drawdown avoidance) says de-risk, not hold. Crowding is negative (z -0.78), so this is neglect, not a contrarian fade.
evidence: eligible false — failed the absolute-trend gate
